tools.name: subagent_status
tools.title: Subagent status
tools.description: Report whether a remote model is configured and list open sessions. Connection details are never returned.

tools.name: subagent_ask
tools.title: Ask the remote model
tools.description: Send one prompt to the configured remote model and return its reply. Use this for a single question with no follow-up.

prompt.description: What to ask the remote model.

system_prompt.description: Optional system prompt for this call. Overrides the configured default.

tools.name: subagent_start
tools.title: Start a subagent session
tools.description: Open a multi-turn conversation with the remote model. Returns a session id to use with subagent_say.

system_prompt.description: System prompt for the whole session. This is the prompt under test.

tools.name: subagent_say
tools.title: Send a turn to the subagent
tools.description: Send the next turn in an open subagent session. History is kept on this side within a bounded rolling window.

tools.name: subagent_end
tools.title: Close a subagent session
tools.description: Discard an open subagent session and its history.
